name: Together AI GPU Clusters - HGX H200 on-demand
price_basis: per H200 SXM GPU-hour, on-demand pay-as-you-go, GPU Clusters product. Fetched 2026-10-04. Preemptible tier is $2.99/GPU-hr. Reserved tiers: 7-30 days $4.99, 31-90 days $4.15, 91-180 days $3.99.
notes: Together AI GPU Clusters on-demand H200 at $5.99/GPU-hr. This is below CoreWeave on-demand H200 ($6.31) and significantly below AWS p5en (H200) which has no published on-demand rate in us-east-1. The preemptible tier at $2.99/GPU-hr is the cheapest published managed-provider H200 rate. Together AI is one of the few providers that publishes preemptible/reserved tiers for H200, making it a reference point for the H200 market.
